messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Dispense 140 units of BSA sample and 140 units of TCA precipitant. Mix the sample and precipitant for 60 seconds. Incubate the mixture at 23C for 5 minutes to precipitate the protein. Dispose of the supernatant. Wash the precipitate 3 times by dispensing 315 units of rinse solution, heating at 23C for 10 seconds, and disposing of the rinse. Dispense 315 units of resolubilization buffer and heat at 95C for 5 minutes to dissolve the protein. Add 13 units of fluorescamine reagent and mix for 60 seconds. Measure the fluorescence of the resolubilized protein for 2 minutes to determine recovery, then dispose of the sample.

module fluorescence

manifest bsa_sample
manifest tca_precipitant
manifest rinse_solution
manifest resolubilization_buffer
manifest fluorescamine_reagent

instructions:

sample = dispense 140 units of bsa_sample
tca = dispense 140 units of tca_precipitant
a = mix sample with tca for 60s
heat a at 23c for 5m

dispose a

repeat 3 times {
    rinse = dispense 315 units of rinse_solution
    heat rinse at 23c for 10s
    dispose rinse
}

resolub = dispense 315 units of resolubilization_buffer
heat resolub at 95c for 5m

fluor = dispense 13 units of fluorescamine_reagent
b = mix resolub with fluor for 60s

recovery_reading = detect fluorescence on b for 2m
dispose b

metadata.notes: Numeric values are mapped directly from the methods section of the Jebrail & Wheeler paper. The droplet sizes for samples/precipitants are 140 nL, mapped to 140 units in BioScript. Rinse and resolubilization droplet sizes are 315 nL, mapped to 315 units. The protocol successfully captures the physical separation step by disposing of the supernatant after precipitation, followed by iterative washing of the solid precipitate.
